RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the August 10, 2007/Sravana 19, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
1
Banned injection in circulation
†*1. SHRI BANWARI LAL
KANCHHAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
Oxadicin, an injection injected to buffalo is
being sold in the country despite a ban on
the same;
(b) whether it is being used to increase
the size of vegetable artificially by injecting
it in fruit and vegetable plants in the country;
(c) if so, whether public health is being
affected adversely by its use;
(d) whether Government would take
strict action to prevent the sale of the said
injection; and
(e) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Compensation to dependents of the
victims of Mumbai blasts
*2. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of
RAILWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of dependents of the
victims of suburban Mumbai rail bomb
blasts of 11 July, 2006, to whom Railways
have, so far, offered/given employment;
(b) the nature of jobs offered/given;
(c) whether it is a fact that even
graduates and post-graduates have been
offered only class IV appointments, if so,
the reasons therefor;
(d) whether his Ministry would follow
a rational policy and give at least class III
appointments to graduates and post-
graduates; and
(e) by when a decision thereon is likely
to be taken?
Increase of medical facilities
†*3. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of major
Government hospitals functioning in the
country;
(b) the number of people getting medical
facilities in each hospital in the country
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
and the average of the same in Uttarakhand;
and
(c) the details of the steps to be taken
to increase the availability of medical
facility in the Tenth Five Year Plan?
Bird flu in Manipur
*4. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are well aware
about the bird flu in Manipur State
recently;
(b) if so, what steps have been taken in
this regard and for the prevention of similar
flu in other States;
(c) the total number of poultry birds
killed and expected to be killed for the
protection of such and other birds in the
country; and
(d) whether this flu has reached India
from China, Tibet or Nepal?
Election to general body/delegates of
CGECCS Ltd.
*5. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether as per the provisions of
Multi-State Cooperative Societies Act,
2002 and bye-law No. 23 (ii) of Central
Government Employees Consumer
Cooperative Society Ltd. (Kendriya
Bhandar), Board of Directors (BoD) are
responsible to conduct election to the
general body/delegates within the stipulated
period;
(b) whether election to the general body/
delegates was conducted in the year 1999
for a period of three years and if so, the
reasons for not ensuring the elections when
they became due; and
(c) the action taken by Central
Registrar, MSCS to conduct the election
on time and to declare BoD ineligible for
continuation/further election as delegate/
member of the Board?
Packages for Vidarbha and its
monitoring
†*6. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the number of packages announced
for the farmers of Vidarbha area of
Maharashtra during the year 2006-07;
(b) the amount provided to the farmers
of Vidarbha from these packages;
(c) whether any inquiry has been
conducted by Government to ascertain that
funds are reaching the farmers or not; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
enable farmers to get rid of debt and
overcome any crisis they may face in the
course of cultivation in the near future?
Import of wheat
†*7. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the names of the countries from
where wheat is being imported by
Government to meet the shortage of wheat
in the country along with the quantity being
imported from each country;
(b) the rate of wheat being imported;
(c) the reasons for not purchasing wheat
from Pakistan and Australia;

3
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) whether Government would ensure
that the wheat being imported from America
is free of weeds; and
(e) the quantity of wheat required for
the country?
Insecticides banned or under review
†*8. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
insecticides have been banned in the
country and some others have been put
into the "Review

1
Increasing of alkaline elements in soil
†1. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that because of
continuous use of chemical fertilizers the
quantity of alkaline elements in the soil in
most parts of the country is increasing
continuously resulting in the decrease in
soil fertility;
(b) if so, what measures are being taken
to check the same; and
(c) if not, the quantum of increase in
production per hectare annually during
each of the past five years?
Popularising MSP
2. SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) what is Minimum Support Price
(MSP) and how the same is fixed and
beneficial to the farmers;
(b) whether the report of the National
Sample Survey Organisation (NSSO) has

Bird flu
3. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the competent authority has
taken control measures regarding the
outbreak of H5N1 avian influenza outbreak
in the north eastern region during the last
two months;
(b) if so, the details including the source
of outbreak, birds culled and the financial
support provided to the poultry farmers/
other citizens as on today, category-wise,
State-wise; and
(c) if so, the details of H5N1 avian
influenza outbreak in various States

2
including the number of birds culled,
financial support provided, source of out-
break, total loss due to the outbreak, steps
taken to control/prevent further outbreak
for the last three years, State-wise, year-
wise and category-wise?
Inclusion of Orissa under NHM
4. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) how many districts of Orissa have
been included under National Horticulture
Mission; and
(b) the details of measures that are
proposed to be taken for development of
horticulture in Orissa?
Horticulture college in Orissa
5. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether ICAR proposes to provide
funds for establishment of one Horticulture
College in Orissa under OVAT and for
development of horticulture sector in the
State; and
(b) if so, the details along with the status
of the project?
Special mission for wheat, rice and
pulses
†6. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to
launch a special mission very soon in order
to increase the production of wheat, rice
and pulses; and
(b) if so, whether any other programme
is also proposed to increase the growth rate
of agriculture sector alongwith the above
programme?
Promotion of vermi compost and bio-
fertilizers
†7. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) the percentage of wastes from urban
and rural areas of the country being used
for preparing vermi compost and other bio-
fertilizers;
(b) whether the wastes from the urban
and rural areas of the State of Uttarakhand
are also being used for preparing vermi
compost and other bio-fertilizers; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
measures taken by Government so far to
encourage it?
Sale of spurious fertilizers, pesticides
and insecticides
8. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that spurious
fertilizers, pesticides and insecticides are
being sold in some parts of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and its
impact on agriculture produce;
(c) the number of cases that has come
to light during last two years; and
(d) the steps taken to prevent production
of spurious fertilizers, pesticides and
insecticides?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
